description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams used for filtering performance tracker log searches. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods related to filtering logs by tracker ID and default sorting settings.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for specifying search filter parameters for performance tracker logs, including sorting options and optional tracker ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting field and order.

methods.name: getTrackerId
methods.description: Returns the tracker ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setTrackerId
methods.description: Sets the tracker ID used as a filter criterion.
